protocol.budget_definition: For each query, cap = externally assigned common prefix_dc P + extra; dc == cap for every method
protocol.prefix_semantics: C/F/SCORE/DIVERSE/KEEP/E64_RAW execute the primary prefix online; FANNG uses P only as an external budget reference
protocol.budget_generation_timing: Common budget manifest generation excluded for all methods; FANNG has no extra C-prefix probe in its online timer
protocol.online_timing: Complete method-specific online search, including distance scoring and any entry selection/state continuation
protocol.timing_wave: Protocol requires a separate full seven-method wave; wave provenance is externally audited
protocol.latency_quantile_definition: linear quantile ((n-1)*p) of per-query median-repetition ns
protocol.primary_test: Exact two-sided McNemar for five adjacent chain comparisons at primary extra, one Holm family across all graphs
protocol.other_tests: Descriptive; all methods vs C and FANNG, every secondary extra, and recall differences
protocol.parameter_selection: none; all requested cells required and reported
protocol.scope: Seven-method fixed-graph search comparison; FANNG search port, not full FANNG index reproduction
